create or alter function [metrics].[ConditionsFiltering] ( @assetId bigint, @conditions varchar(max), @matchConditionsOnly bit ) RETURNS @results TABLE ( [Include] bit, MatchUid uniqueidentifier, Threshold float, Weight float, OtherMatches varchar(500) ) AS BEGIN declare @include bit = 0;
declare @tConditions table (PositionAuto Int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, Uid uniqueidentifier, MatchType int, Position int, Threshold float, Weight float, ConditionType int, Operator int, [Type] varchar(50), LookupObjectType varchar(250), LookupObjectID int, FieldTypeId int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), StartRangeValue nvarchar(max), EndRangeValue nvarchar(max), SingleValue nvarchar(max), [Values] nvarchar(max), Passed bit default(0) ); insert into @tConditions select g.Uid, g.MatchType, g.Position, g.Threshold, g.Weight, i.ConditionType, i.Operator, i.[Type], i.LookupObjectType, i.LookupObjectID, i.FieldTypeId, i.FieldTypeName, i.StartRangeValue, i.EndRangeValue, i.SingleValue, i.[Values], 0 from openjson(@conditions) with ( Uid uniqueidentifier, MatchType int, Position int, Threshold float, Weight float, Items nvarchar(max) as json ) g outer apply openjson(g.Items) with ( Uid uniqueidentifier, ConditionType int, Operator int, [Type] varchar(50), LookupObjectType varchar(250), LookupObjectID int, FieldTypeId int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), StartRangeValue nvarchar(max), EndRangeValue nvarchar(max), SingleValue nvarchar(max), [Values] nvarchar(max) as json ) i order by g.Position;
if not exists (select 1 from @tConditions) begin -- There are no conditions defined for this measure. insert into @Results ([Include]) values (1) end else begin declare @currentPosition int = 1, @maxPosition int, @matchUid uniqueidentifier, @threshold float, @weight float, @otherMatches nvarchar(500) = '[]';
select @maxPosition = max(PositionAuto), @currentPosition = coalesce(min(PositionAuto),1) from @tConditions;
while @currentPosition <= @maxPosition begin
-- Populated. These checks must be separate from type-level checks below. if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Operator = 10 and PositionAuto = @currentPosition) begin update c set c.Passed = iif(f.[Count] > 0, 1, 0) from @tConditions c cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from dbo.Field where FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and AssetID = @assetId and FormattedValue is not null and FormattedValue <> '' ) f where c.Operator = 10 and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition; end
-- Not Populated. These checks must be separate from type-level checks below. if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Operator = 11 and PositionAuto = @currentPosition) begin update c set c.Passed = iif(f.[Count] = 0, 1, 0) from @tConditions c cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from dbo.Field where FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and AssetID = @assetId and FormattedValue is not null and FormattedValue <> '' ) f where c.Operator = 11 and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition; end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'Boolean' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and c.[Type] = 'Boolean' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) and f.AssetID = @assetId and case when c.Operator = 1 and lower(f.FormattedValue) = lower(c.SingleValue) then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and lower(f.FormattedValue) <> lower(c.SingleValue) then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 18 and lower(f.FormattedValue) in ('true', '1') then 1 -- IsTrue when c.Operator = 19 and (lower(f.FormattedValue) in ('false', '0') or f.FormattedValue is null) then 1 -- IsFalse else 0 end = 1 end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'Date' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and c.[Type] = 'Date' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) and f.AssetID = @assetId and case when c.Operator = 1 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) = try_cast(c.SingleValue as date) then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) <> try_cast(c.SingleValue as date) then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 9 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) between try_cast(c.StartRangeValue as date) and try_cast(c.EndRangeValue as date) then 1 -- Between when c.Operator in (8, 12) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) > try_cast(c.SingleValue as date) then 1 -- GreaterThan when c.Operator in (13, 20) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) <= try_cast(c.SingleValue as date) then 1 -- LessThanOrEquals when c.Operator in (7, 14) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) < try_cast(c.SingleValue as date) then 1 -- LessThan when c.Operator in (15, 21) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as date) >= try_cast(c.SingleValue as date) then 1 -- GreaterThanOrEquals else 0 end = 1 end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'DateTime' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and c.[Type] = 'DateTime' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) and f.AssetID = @assetId and case when c.Operator = 1 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) = try_cast(c.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) <> try_cast(c.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 9 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) between try_cast(c.StartRangeValue as datetime) and try_cast(c.EndRangeValue as datetime) then 1 -- Between when c.Operator in (8, 12) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) > try_cast(c.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 -- GreaterThan when c.Operator in (13, 20) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) <= try_cast(c.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 -- LessThanOrEquals when c.Operator in (7, 14) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) < try_cast(c.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 -- LessThan when c.Operator in (15, 21) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as datetime) >= try_cast(c.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 -- GreaterThanOrEquals else 0 end = 1 end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'Decimal' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and c.[Type] = 'Decimal' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) and f.AssetID = @assetId and case when c.Operator = 1 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) = try_cast(c.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) <> try_cast(c.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 9 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) between try_cast(c.StartRangeValue as decimal) and try_cast(c.EndRangeValue as decimal) then 1 -- Between when c.Operator = 12 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) > try_cast(c.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 -- GreaterThan when c.Operator = 13 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) <= try_cast(c.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 -- LessThanOrEquals when c.Operator = 14 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) < try_cast(c.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 -- LessThan when c.Operator = 15 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as decimal) >= try_cast(c.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 -- GreaterThanOrEquals else 0 end = 1 end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'Number' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and c.[Type] = 'Number' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) and f.AssetID = @assetId and case when c.Operator = 1 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) = try_cast(c.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) <> try_cast(c.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 9 and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) between try_cast(c.StartRangeValue as bigint) and try_cast(c.EndRangeValue as bigint) then 1 -- Between when c.Operator in (8, 12) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) > try_cast(c.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 -- GreaterThan when c.Operator in (13, 20) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) <= try_cast(c.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 -- LessThanOrEquals when c.Operator in (7, 14) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) < try_cast(c.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 -- LessThan when c.Operator in (15, 21) and try_cast(f.FormattedValue as bigint) >= try_cast(c.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 -- GreaterThanOrEquals else 0 end = 1 end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'Text' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and c.[Type] = 'Text' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) and f.AssetID = @assetId and case when c.Operator = 1 and f.FormattedValue = c.SingleValue then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and f.FormattedValue <> c.SingleValue then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 3 and f.FormattedValue like '%' + c.SingleValue + '%' then 1 -- Contains when c.Operator = 4 and f.FormattedValue not like '%' + c.SingleValue + '%' then 1 -- NotContains when c.Operator = 5 and f.FormattedValue like c.SingleValue + '%' then 1 -- StartsWith when c.Operator = 6 and f.FormattedValue like '%' + c.SingleValue then 1 -- EndWith when c.Operator = 16 and f.FormattedValue in ( select [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 -- In when c.Operator = 17 and f.FormattedValue not in ( select [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 -- NotIn else 0 end = 1 end
if exists (select 1 from @tConditions where Type = 'Lookup' and PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Operator not in (10, 11)) begin update c set c.Passed = 1 from @tConditions c inner join dbo.Field f on f.FieldTypeID = c.FieldTypeId and f.AssetID = @assetId and c.[Type] = 'Lookup' and c.[PositionAuto] = @currentPosition and c.Operator not in (10, 11) inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.ID = f.FieldTypeID inner join dbo.AssetType t on t.Object = c.LookupObjectType+'Type' and t.ObjectId = c.LookupObjectID where exists ( select 1 from dbo.Asset a cross apply ( select try_parse(value as int) as ObjectID from string_split(coalesce(f.Value,'0'), ',') ) vals where a.AssetTypeID = t.ID and a.ObjectID = vals.ObjectID and case when c.Operator = 1 and a.Uid = try_cast(c.SingleValue as uniqueidentifier) then 1 -- Equals when c.Operator = 2 and a.Uid <> try_cast(c.SingleValue as uniqueidentifier) then 1 -- NotEquals when c.Operator = 16 and a.Uid in ( select [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 -- In when c.Operator = 17 and a.Uid not in ( select [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 -- NotIn else 0 end = 1 ); end
-- finally, check if all criteria for the group are matched. if not exists(select 1 from @tConditions where PositionAuto = @currentPosition and Passed = 0) begin set @include = 1 declare @currentMatchUid uniqueidentifier = null, @currentThreshold float, @currentWeight float;
select top 1 @currentMatchUid = Uid, @currentThreshold = Threshold, @currentWeight = Weight from @tConditions where PositionAuto = @currentPosition
if @matchUid is null begin set @matchUid = @currentMatchUid; set @threshold = @currentThreshold set @weight = @currentWeight end else begin set @otherMatches = JSON_MODIFY( @otherMatches, 'append $', cast(@currentMatchUid as varchar(50)) ) end end
set @currentPosition = @currentPosition + 1; end
-- If this set to 0, then this condition check is just to see if there are overriding weights and/or thresholds. if @matchConditionsOnly = 0 begin set @include = 1 end
insert into @results values (@include, @matchUid, @threshold, @weight, @otherMatches) end --select * from @results RETURN END
